questions.question_text: Which Python data type is utilized to store a sequence of alphanumeric text characters enclosed in quotes?
Define Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) in the direct context of digital content creation. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Intellectual Property Rights refer to legal protections granted to creators over their original digital works, preventing unauthorized copying, distribution, or theft of their ideas and software.

questions.question_text: Explain the primary logic and function of an 'if-else' conditional block in Python programming. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An 'if-else' block allows a program to make decisions by executing one specific set of code if a condition is true, and a different set if false.

questions.question_text: State two essential safety protocols a user must follow while making online e-commerce transactions. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Always verify the website URL has HTTPS encryption before entering payment details, and avoid using public Wi-Fi networks when making sensitive financial transactions online.

questions.question_text: Describe the operational role of a 'sprite' within a Scratch visual programming environment. [15-25 words]
questions.answer: A sprite is a primary graphical character or object in Scratch that can be programmed to move, interact, and execute scripts on the stage.

questions.question_text: What is the specific functional difference between the '=' and '==' operators in Python scripts? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The single '=' is an assignment operator used to store values in variables, whereas the double '==' is a relational operator used to compare two values.

sections.section_name: Section C - Short Answer Application Problems

questions.question_text: Write a complete Python script using a 'for' loop to calculate and print the first five multiples of the number 3. [30-40 words]
questions.answer:
The Python code utilizes a 'for' loop combined with the 'range' function:
for i in range(1, 6):
    print(3 * i)
This loop iterates five times, multiplying each index by three to output 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15 successfully.

questions.question_text: A student uses someone else's code for a school project without giving credit. Identify this ethical violation and explain how to avoid it. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: This violation is known as plagiarism. To avoid it, the student must properly cite the original creator, provide a reference link, and ensure they have the appropriate permission or open-source license to use the code.

sections.section_name: Section D - Long Answer / Code-Writing and Troubleshooting Scenarios

questions.question_text: Write a complete Python program that accepts an integer input from the user and checks whether the number is positive, negative, or zero using if-elif-else statements. [50-60 words]

Analyze the following Python code intended to print numbers from 10 down to 1: 
n = 10 
while n > 0: 
    print(n) 
Identify the logical error, explain why it causes an infinite loop, and write the corrected code. [50-60 words]
questions.answer:
The code misses a decrement statement, meaning 'n' remains 10 forever, causing an infinite loop. The corrected script must subtract one during each iteration:
n = 10
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
This ensures the loop variable eventually reaches zero, safely terminating the process without freezing the system.
